name: Murtaugh
text: Murtaugh is an anglicized spelling of the Irish male name Muirchertach, best known from the legendary high king Muirchertach mac Erca. Mortimer and Monty rank among the name's other English forms.

attributes.attribute: anglicization of the Irish name Muirchertach
form tied above all to Muirchertach mac Erca

okr.objective: Documents Murtaugh as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Murtaugh anglicizes the Irish male name Muirchertach.
Its most famous bearer is the high king Muirchertach mac Erca.
